targetRegion: Japanese apartment sliding sash fallback benchmark
manufacture: Interior crescent lock for a two-leaf aluminium sliding sash, reconstructed as a discrete factory-made lock body, pivoting curved lever, keeper and two mechanical fixing screws. The visible benchmark surface is a dark bronze/brown factory coating over a metal lock body; the coating, not bare substrate metal, defines the optical response.
dimensionsThickness: Reference mounting-screw pitch is 50 mm. Generated fallback uses a 72 x 18 x 6 mm lock mounting plate, two 9 mm screw heads on 50 mm centres, a 12 mm pivot boss, a 38 x 12 x 8 mm keeper and an approximately 28 mm-radius segmented crescent lever. These dimensions are a conservative reconstruction around the verified screw pitch rather than a claim of exact product-section identity.
materialsFinish: Dry low-satin dark bronze/brown opaque coating over a metal lock body. The visible coating is dielectric: metallic 0.0, dielectric F0 0.04, roughness about 0.60. Manufactured bevels and the curved lever create the highlight shape; no highlight or shadow is painted into albedo.
mounting: The plate is mechanically fixed to the room-side meeting stile with two vertically spaced screws. The crescent lever rotates about the plate boss and closes against a separate keeper on the opposing meeting stile. The assembly sits behind the exterior glass planes and does not bridge the sash drainage track or penetrate the optical pane.
interfacesGapsSeals: Plate, pivot, lever, keeper and screw heads remain physically separate with millimetre-scale relief. The lock sits on the interior side of the sash meeting line, behind the two depth-separated glass leaves, with a small gap between lever and keeper in the benchmark unlocked-neutral pose. No component may float in front of the glazing or merge into the EPDM gasket.
orientationExposure: Interior-facing sash hardware viewed through exterior glazing. It receives sky/sun only through the glass stack, household contact and limited UV through glazing, but no direct exterior rain or splash in the dry benchmark state.
aging: Cause-based variation is restrained to mild coating dulling, slight hand-contact polishing on the lever edge and dust in protected plate/keeper recesses. No exterior runoff, ferrous bleed, random grime field or directionally baked illumination is permitted.
geometryVsMaterial: Plate thickness, screw heads, pivot boss, lever curvature, keeper, mounting offsets and all silhouette/contact gaps are geometry. Fine coating grain, subtle contact polish and sub-millimetre surface roughness are material response. Lighting, Fresnel and contact shadow remain runtime phenomena.
lodPolicy: Each of the 30 lock assemblies owns LOD0/1/2/3. LOD0 preserves plate, two screw heads, pivot, keeper and five bevelled lever segments; LOD1 preserves plate, keeper and a three-segment lever; LOD2 preserves plate plus one simplified lever proxy; LOD3 preserves only the lock-value silhouette. Animated cross-fade is mandatory and visible pop remains a render-only critical defect.
sourceBasis: LIXIL/Tostem service part AAAZC07L is documented for Atmos II from 1996-10 and other late-1990s products, with a 50 mm mounting-screw pitch and metal construction. That official service-part record supports the period, component class, handed two-panel-window use and screw pitch; this fallback does not claim its full shape is an exact AAAZC07L reproduction. Reference reviewed 2026-09-14: https://store.lixil.co.jp/aaazc07l.html

material.microstructure: sub-millimetre coating grain below the benchmark hardware silhouette scale; no directional highlight texture
material.angularFresnelResponse: weak dielectric frontal reflection with a natural grazing increase; coating roughness keeps the lobe broad and prevents chrome-like sparkle

lookdevGenerationBrief: 4K lookdev plate of a late-1990s Japanese aluminium two-leaf sliding sash viewed from outside in clear midsummer daylight. Show the room-side crescent lock behind clear glazing at the meeting stiles: dark bronze/brown coated metal plate with two visible screws on 50 mm centres, a small pivot boss, curved crescent lever and opposing keeper. Provide frontal, 35-degree oblique and grazing-light views plus a 100% crop. The lock must read as hardware behind glass, not a black mark on the pane. Glass reflections remain physically in front; the coated lock stays broad-rough dielectric with subtle edge response. Include an oblique LOD walk check for pop/shimmer.
